concept.title: Processor telemetry overview
concept.shortdesc: Processor telemetry provides information about how a processor is behaving while workloads execute.

conbody.p: Telemetry data can help engineers understand processor utilisation, workload behaviour, and potential performance bottlenecks.

section.title: Performance monitoring
section.p: Modern processors provide hardware mechanisms for collecting information about events that occur while software is running. These events can include executed instructions, processor cycles, cache activity, and other architectural events.

section.title: Performance Monitoring Unit
section.p: A Performance Monitoring Unit (PMU) provides counters that can record selected processor events. Software tools can read these counters and use the resulting data for performance analysis.

section.title: Using telemetry data
section.p: Individual counters are useful, but meaningful performance analysis often requires interpreting multiple measurements together. Metrics can combine lower-level measurements into information that is easier to use when analysing workload behaviour.
